topics.description: Former FBI Director Robert Mueller, who led the investigation into Russian interference in the 2016 US presidential election, has died at the age of 81. Mueller's investigation led to numerous convictions and guilty pleas of high-profile individuals and entities.

A sentencing date has been set for Aimee Bock, the former executive director of Feeding Our Future, who was convicted of wire fraud and conspiracy. The organization was accused of misusing $5.2 million meant for food assistance programs.
